For instance if [[MATH_199]] is the class of
all planar graphs, Eppstein~[[CITE_200]] gave an fixed-parameter tractable algorithm
for [[MATH_201]]; a similar result is known even for classes of bounded
local treewidth~[[CITE_202]]. Hence, there are also fixed-parameter tractable algorithms
solving [[MATH_203]] for any graph class~[[MATH_204]].\!
fails.zh: 例如，若 [[MATH_199]] 是所有平面图构成的类，Eppstein~[[CITE_200]] 给出了一个针对 [[MATH_201]] 的固定参数可解算法；类似的结果甚至对具有有界局部树宽的图类也已知~[[CITE_202]]。因此，对于任意图类 [[MATH_204]]，也存在求解 [[MATH_203]] 的固定参数可解算法。\!

An alternative low-scale LNV can be realized in models with {\em spontaneous} global [[MATH_166]] violation, which implies the existence of a massless Goldstone boson called the Majoron~[[CITE_167]]  [[COMMENT_168]]
with potentially interesting phenomenological consequences for [[MATH_169]]~[[CITE_170]], leptogenesis~[[CITE_171]], DM~[[CITE_172]] and inflation~[[CITE_173]]. In the context of supersymmetry, both [[MATH_174]] and [[MATH_175]]-parity can be spontaneously broken by the VEV of the RH sneutrino field, leading to a minimal model of [[MATH_176]]-parity violation~[[CITE_177]].
fails.zh:
另一种低尺度LNV可以在具有{\em自发}全局[[MATH_166]]破坏的模型中实现，这意味着存在一种被称为Majoron的无质量Goldstone玻色子~[[CITE_167]]  [[COMMENT_168]]
对[[MATH_169]]~[[CITE_170]]、轻子生成~[[CITE_171]]、DM~[[CITE_172]]和暴胀~[[CITE_173]]具有潜在有趣的唯象学后果。在超对称的背景下，[[MATH_174]]和[[MATH_175]]-宇称都可以通过右手标量中微子场的VEV自发破缺，从而产生一个最小的[[MATH_176]]-宇称破坏模型~[[CITE_177]]。

An alternative low-scale LNV can be realized in models with {\em spontaneous} global [[MATH_166]] violation, which implies the existence of a massless Goldstone boson called the Majoron~[[CITE_167]]  [[COMMENT_168]]
with potentially interesting phenomenological consequences for [[MATH_169]]~[[CITE_170]], leptogenesis~[[CITE_171]], DM~[[CITE_172]] and inflation~[[CITE_173]]. In the context of supersymmetry, both [[MATH_174]] and [[MATH_175]]-parity can be spontaneously broken by the VEV of the RH sneutrino field, leading to a minimal model of [[MATH_176]]-parity violation~[[CITE_177]].
fails.zh: 一种可替代的低能标轻子数破坏可以在具有{\em 自发}整体[[MATH_166]]对称性破坏的模型中实现，这意味着存在一个被称为Majoron的无质量Goldstone玻色子[[CITE_167]]  [[COMMENT_168]]，并可能对[[MATH_169]]~[[CITE_170]]、轻子生成~[[CITE_171]]、暗物质~[[CITE_172]]以及暴胀~[[CITE_173]]产生有潜在趣味的唯象学后果。在超对称背景下，右手中微子超伴子场的真空期望值可以同时自发破坏[[MATH_174]]和[[MATH_175]]-宇称，从而给出一个[[MATH_176]]-宇称破坏的最小模型[[CITE_177]]。
